name: Playwright Browser
description: Browser automation via Microsoft Playwright MCP — presets for an isolated headless browser or attaching to Chrome/Edge, plus a /browser setup guide.
author: cognia-next

permissionJustifications.extension:ui: Opens the /browser setup guide modal that explains each preset and links into MCP settings.
permissionJustifications.shell:execute: Runs `node --version` and `npx --version` when you press 'Check environment' in the /browser guide — the only two commands, both covered by shellCommands.

browser.reason: Requires npx to spawn @playwright/mcp@latest — desktop only.

mobile.reason: Spawns @playwright/mcp via npx — unavailable on mobile.

commands.name: /browser
commands.description: Open the Playwright browser setup guide — compare the presets and jump to the right gallery card.

mcpServerPresets.name: Playwright — Isolated
mcpServerPresets.description: Disposable in-memory browser profile — nothing persists between runs — driven headless so no window opens.

mcpServerPresets.name: Playwright — Attach over CDP
mcpServerPresets.description: Attach to a Chrome or Edge you launched yourself with --remote-debugging-port — for dev loops and inspecting a live session.

fields.label: CDP endpoint
fields.description: Start the browser first, e.g. chrome --remote-debugging-port=9222, then paste its CDP URL.

en.manifest.name: Playwright Browser
en.manifest.description: Browser automation via Microsoft Playwright MCP — presets for an isolated headless browser or attaching to Chrome/Edge, plus a /browser setup guide.
en.modal.title: Set up a Playwright browser
en.modal.subtitle: Pick how the agent should drive a browser. Each option adds a Playwright MCP server you can enable and attach to an agent.
en.modal.env.label: Environment
en.modal.env.missing: Node.js or npx was not found. Install Node.js 18+ first.
en.modal.env.unavailable: Shell access is unavailable in this host, so the check cannot run.
en.modal.env.error: The check could not run — the command was denied or failed.
en.modal.env.hint: Every preset spawns `npx @playwright/mcp` — Node.js 18+ must be on the PATH the app sees.
en.modal.afterAdd: A server added from a preset starts disabled — enable it, then attach it to an agent in the character editor.
en.mode.playwright.desc: A fresh, persistent browser profile. Runs headed by default — add --headless to the server args if you do not want a visible window.
en.mode.isolated.desc: A disposable in-memory profile that keeps nothing between runs, headless so no window opens. The privacy-preserving default for unattended tasks.
en.mode.existing.desc: Drives selected tabs in the Chrome or Edge you already use, reusing its profile and login state through the official Playwright extension.
en.mode.cdp.desc: Attaches to a Chrome or Edge you launched yourself with --remote-debugging-port — for dev loops and inspecting a live session.
en.mode.existing.safety: browser_run_code_unsafe is denied by default on this preset.
en.command.opened: Opened the Playwright browser setup guide.
en.commands.browser.description: Open the Playwright browser setup guide — compare the presets and jump to the right gallery card.

zh-CN.manifest.name: Playwright 浏览器
zh-CN.manifest.description: 通过 Microsoft Playwright MCP 实现浏览器自动化——提供隔离的无头浏览器或连接 Chrome/Edge 的预设，以及 /browser 配置指南。
zh-CN.modal.title: 配置 Playwright 浏览器
zh-CN.modal.subtitle: 选择让 Agent 驱动浏览器的方式。每种方式都会添加一个 Playwright MCP 服务器，启用后可挂载到 Agent。
zh-CN.modal.env.label: 环境
zh-CN.modal.env.missing: 未找到 Node.js 或 npx，请先安装 Node.js 18+。
zh-CN.modal.env.unavailable: 当前宿主不支持 Shell 访问，无法执行检查。
zh-CN.modal.env.error: 检查未能执行——命令被拒绝或运行失败。
zh-CN.modal.env.hint: 每个预设都会启动 `npx @playwright/mcp`——应用进程的 PATH 中需要有 Node.js 18+。
zh-CN.modal.afterAdd: 通过预设添加的服务器默认处于停用状态——请先启用，再在角色编辑器中把它挂载到 Agent。
zh-CN.mode.playwright.desc: 全新的持久化浏览器配置。默认以有头模式运行——如果不想看到浏览器窗口，请在服务器参数中加上 --headless。
zh-CN.mode.isolated.desc: 用完即弃的内存配置，运行之间不保留任何状态，且无头运行不弹窗。适合无人值守任务的隐私默认项。
zh-CN.mode.existing.desc: 通过官方 Playwright 扩展驱动你日常使用的 Chrome 或 Edge 中已选定的标签页，复用其配置与登录状态。
zh-CN.mode.cdp.desc: 附加到你自己用 --remote-debugging-port 启动的 Chrome 或 Edge——适合开发调试和观察运行中的会话。
zh-CN.req.extension: 需要官方 Playwright 扩展
zh-CN.req.approval: 每个标签页连接都需你批准
zh-CN.req.cdpPort: 需要你以 --remote-debugging-port 启动浏览器
zh-CN.mode.existing.safety: 该预设默认禁用 browser_run_code_unsafe 工具。
zh-CN.command.opened: 已打开 Playwright 浏览器配置向导。
zh-CN.commands.browser.description: 打开 Playwright 浏览器配置指南：比较预设并跳转到对应的图库卡片。
